title: Dull, Dirty, Dangerous? Working Conditions and the Limits of Occupational AI Exposure
abstract: arXiv:2611.06888v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automation is often justified as relief from dull, dirty, and dangerous work. I examine how these conditions relate to occupational AI exposure using 21 O*NET items across 754 US occupations. Higher exposure is associated with lower condition scores under a large language model (LLM) measure and AI Occupational Exposure (AIOE), with equal occupation weights and employment weights. Adjustment for physical demands, required education, training and experience, and wages reduces the composite association. The adjusted confidence intervals include zero for LLM exposure and remain below zero for AIOE. Separating repetition from restricted discretion also changes what the combined Dull score conveys. These comparisons show how item groupings and occupational characteristics shape the interpretation of exposure estimates. translated_title: 枯燥、肮脏、危险？工作条件与职业AI暴露度指标解释的局限性
translated_abstract: 自动化常被论证为是将人们从枯燥、肮脏和危险的工作中解脱出来的手段。我利用涵盖754个美国职业的21个O*NET条目，考察了这些工作条件与职业AI暴露度之间的关系。在大语言模型（LLM）度量和AI职业暴露度（AIOE）指标下，无论采用等权职业权重还是就业权重，较高的暴露度都与较低的工作条件评分相关。在对体力要求、所需教育、培训和经验以及工资进行调整后，这种综合关联性有所减弱。调整后的置信区间在LLM暴露度方面包含零，而AIOE的置信区间仍低于零。将重复性与受限自主权分开处理，也会改变合并后的“枯燥”分数所传达的含义。这些比较表明，条目分组方式和职业特征会影响对暴露度估计结果的解释。职业画像为选择具有对比性的研究场景提供了起点。确定期望的自动化或……
tldr: 该研究发现“枯燥、肮脏、危险”的工作条件与职业AI暴露度之间的关联在控制体力要求、教育培训和工资等职业特征后会显著减弱甚至消失，揭示了当前常用AI暴露度指标在解释上的局限性。
en_tdlr: This study finds that the association between "dull, dirty, dangerous" working conditions and occupational AI exposure weakens or becomes insignificant after adjusting for physical demands, education, training, and wages, revealing the limits of interpreting common AI exposure measures.
